item.title: Ghibli Museum — Guide
item.description: The Ghibli Museum in Mitaka, western Tokyo, is a magical, whimsical museum dedicated to the works of Studio Ghibli, the legendary animation studio behind films like My Neighbour Totoro, Spirited Away and Princess Mononoke. Designed under the direction of Hayao Miyazaki himself, the museum is a playful, storybook-like building full of winding staircases, stained glass, hidden nooks and surprises, deliberately laid out to be explored freely rather than in a set route.
